schema_policy: All named CSV columns become ordered, non-null PostgreSQL TEXT columns. Preserve strings, Unicode, empty strings, duplicate rows and value multiplicities. No numeric coercion, status filtering or inferred business rules.
required_columns_policy: Explicit control schema consists of every header in the unchanged nominal public CSV. This is a new declared development contract, not recovery of an undocumented original business schema.
scope: New bounded local-file to real PostgreSQL mechanism controls, no LLM and no model/source workflow execution. Original PostgreSQL mock binding is not silently reused. Public resource, schema/write semantics, and dataset-reference receipt are explicit v2 additions. SFTP, scheduling, production connections, non-TEXT typing, filtering, upsert, restore and full original-task equivalence are not claimed. No M0-M5 or original G6-Assert scores are replaced.
